ambient: Something occurs, a step and a half away.
The edge stays where it is.
The arranged part gets slightly brighter and no larger.
description: Whatever is happening is happening, and you're just next to it, at the edge where the light stops being about anything. Nothing here is hidden from you. You're simply not in the part of it that was arranged.
name: Off To One Side

looks: Lit, occupied, and about a step and a half away.
Nobody in it's excluding you. That would take noticing you.
It carries on being the arrangement whether you attend to it or not.
objects.name: the part that was arranged

looks: Comfortable, and not a good place to stay.
It goes all the way round, so there's no far side to get to.
You have been standing on it since you got here.
objects.name: the edge you're on
